reaction: The contrast between resilience and resistance to compression makes the combination satisfying and clear.
reason: Adding cells and blood vessels is the only offered combination and should turn the matrix into living bone tissue.
expectation: I expect living bone tissue containing the mineralized matrix, cells and vessels.

effect: The matrix now contains cells and a blood vessel, forming living bone tissue; the next offered step connects it to the arm bones.
reaction: The result is clear, though it adds little explanation of what the cells and vessel do.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it should build the arm bones from the living tissue.
expectation: I expect arm bones made of living bone tissue, ready for the joint components.

effect: The living tissue and arm bones formed an elbow assembly with slots for cartilage and a capsule; the result explains how each supports movement.
reaction: The explanation makes the joint components' purposes clear, though the assembly appeared more quickly than I expected.

effect: The cartilage is fitted; the capsule remains the next joint component.

expectation: I expect the capsule and synovial lining to be fitted around the cartilage-covered joint.

effect: The capsule and synovial lining are fitted, leaving ligaments as the offered next component.
reason: Ligaments are the only offered combination and should help stabilize the elbow.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to connect across the joint and complete the supported elbow.

effect: Adding ligaments produced a movable arm skeleton and completed the supported elbow goal.
reaction: The completed joint is a satisfying result, though I wanted more explanation of how ligaments stabilize it.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining collagen and mineral was most worthwhile because the result explained how their different properties contribute to bone.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive cartilage and capsule fittings felt repetitive because their results only confirmed placement; their functions had already been explained.

surprise.text: I was surprised that combining living bone tissue with arm bones produced an elbow assembly so quickly.

arbitrary.text: Combining living bone tissue with arm bones felt slightly unclear: the arm bones were already named as bones, so their relationship to the added tissue was not obvious.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter to see how the supported joint connects to muscle and movement, especially if the results explain those relationships as clearly as the bone matrix did.
